snp2.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati ṭaṅkitamañce sūcilomayakkhassa bhavane.
snp2.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena kharo ca yakkho sūcilomo ca yakkho bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
snp2.5:1.4: atha kho kharo yakkho sūcilomaṃ yakkhaṃ etadavoca
snp2.5:1.7: yāva ahaṃ pajānāmi yadi vā samaṇo yadi vā samaṇakoti.
snp2.5:2.1: atha kho sūcilomo yakkho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesi.
snp2.5:2.3: atha kho sūcilomo yakkho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
snp2.5:3.2: sace me na byākāsi cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi hadayaṃ vā te phālessāmi pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipissāmīti.
snp2.5:4.1: na khvāhantaṃ āvuso passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo me cittaṃ vā khipeyya hadayaṃ vā phāleyya pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipeyya
snp2.5:4.2: api ca tvaṃ āvuso puccha yadākaṅkhasīti.
snp2.5:4.3: atha kho sūcilomo yakkho bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
snp2.5:8.5: sūcilomasuttaṃ pañcamaṃ. suttanipāte dutiyassa cūḷavaggassa chaṭṭhaṃ dhammacariyasuttaṃ 6
